newsitem.title: GREECE: Intrasoft signs 2.8bln contract with EU.
newsitem.headline: Intrasoft signs 2.8bln contract with EU.

text.p: Software house Intrasoft said on Monday it signed a 2.8 billion drachma four-year contract with the European Commission to provide information technology services under the EU's PROSOMA project.

The Intrasoft-led joint venture was awarded the contract after an international tender. It prevailed over Italy's Olivetti, Oracle Belgium, Finsiel, Guinti Multimedia and Multimedia Corporation, it said.

"PROSOMA aims to optimise diffusion of ESPRIT results through innnovative technologies based on multimedia. PROSOMA information will be accessible via Internet and will be distributed through CD-ROM," Intrasoft said.
The company will provide electronic production and diffusion services aiming to the development of PROSOMA.
